levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن عبد الله بن أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي
أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي
علي بن أحمد بن عبد الله بن أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي
أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: two sayings: the Imam's long answer to al-Mansur (saying 1, the Imam last), and the Imam's own chain for the Prophet's account of Ali's rank (saying 2; it keeps the head up to the Imam, as in example 3)
the Imam is the last link of saying 1 (owner ruling 5) and a narrator in saying 2; the bracketed footnote numbers «(1)», «(3)» are left out
the first head is a bare «حدثنا أبي» (relation), and the bare relations in the Imam's chain (أبي, أبيه, جده) are not identified (rule 9)
the Mansur's and Rabi's remarks are not links
